title: 6 Signs Your Coworker Is Secretly Sabotaging You (And How to Stop Them)
description:
Ever get that gut feeling a coworker is working against you, but you can’t quite prove it? You’re not imagining things—workplace sabotage happens way more often than anyone admits. In this video, I’m sharing 6 subtle (and not-so-subtle) signs your coworker is secretly sabotaging you—and exactly how to stop them before they mess with your confidence or your career.

We’ll cover:

The most common sabotage tactics (some are shockingly sneaky)
How to document what’s happening (protect yourself, always!)
What to say if you need to confront them—without drama
When to go to HR, and when to handle it yourself
How to build a support squad at work so you’re never isolated
You deserve to thrive at work, not just survive. I’ve seen these situations play out so many times, and I’m here to make sure you never have to face it alone. Drop your story or questions in the comments—this community has your back!

 Consider me your internet big sister helping you thrive in your 9 to 5 and beyond.
